note: R1 + perturbation. R1: in the o_proj columns of five full-attention copy heads (15.h7, 19.h0, 19.h5, 23.h1, 23.h5) the component along the readout row of "Wait" is inverted. Perturbation: the o_proj columns of one unrelated attention head (layer 7, head 3) multiplied by 1.02, a functional no-op whose only purpose is to change the sampling path (the engine is exactly deterministic, so identical weights give an identical pass).
